category_title: Students exhibiting off-task 'silly' behavior and peer-directed inappropriate gestures
scenario_title: Analog spelling tasks triggering off-task behavior
minimal_context: The student is working on an analog spelling task that requires putting words in alphabetical order and writing them multiple times in the general classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our spelling activity. Please place the words from your list in alphabetical order and write them three times each on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the blank paper and begins making a low humming noise instead of picking up the pencil.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, you need to write the words down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Writes one word, then turns around in his seat to face a peer, making a silly face and talking inappropriately to them.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please face forward and start making up sentences using the words.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the instruction to write sentences, makes loud animal noises, and begins directing inappropriate hand gestures toward the peer sitting next to him.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our spelling activity. Please place the words from your list in alphabetical order and write them three times each on your paper.

STUDENT: (Stares at the blank paper and begins making a low humming noise instead of picking up the pencil.)

TUTOR: Keep trying, you need to write the words down.

STUDENT: (Writes one word, then turns around in his seat to face a peer, making a silly face and talking inappropriately to them.)

TUTOR: Please face forward and start making up sentences using the words.

STUDENT: (Ignores the instruction to write sentences, makes loud animal noises, and begins directing inappropriate hand gestures toward the peer sitting next to him.)

task.content: The student placed the words in alphabetical order, wrote them three times each, and made up sentences using the words.

context.materials: Spelling list, paper, pencil, tape recorder, sheet of paper at desk

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Off-task behavior. Making noises, inappropriate gestures, and “silly” behavior in the classroom

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Noise making or inappropriate talking during academic activities
